title: Ocean Plastic 60
script:
Every year, eight million tons of plastic flow into our oceans. [Visual: ocean_reel_scene_1_cand_1.jpeg]
Where does it all come from? [Visual: ocean_reel_s1.mp4]
It drifts for decades, breaking into tiny fragments. [Visual: ocean_reel_scene_3_cand_1.jpeg]
The journey spans generations. [Visual: ocean_reel_s3.mp4]
Marine animals mistake it for food. [Visual: ocean_reel_scene_5_cand_1.jpeg]
But change is possible. Start today. [Visual: ocean_reel_scene_6_cand_1.jpeg]
